title: Warden - Staff Utilities
description: Warden Staff Utilities is an all-in-one staff management and moderation plugin built for Spigot/Paper 1.21+, designed to give server staff powerful tools while keeping workflows fast and intuitive.
body:
Warden Staff Utilities is a comprehensive staff management and moderation plugin designed for Spigot/Paper 1.21+. It provides professional-grade tools for server staff while maintaining a clean and intuitive user experience.

Features include an advanced vanish system with customizable join and leave messages, allowing staff to remain hidden from players and the tab list. The plugin also offers a moderator mode for seamless spectating and player monitoring, keeping staff tools separate from survival gameplay.

Staff members can view player inventories in real time using the /invsee command, making investigations and cheat detection easier. A private staff chat channel allows team communication to remain hidden from regular players.

Warden Staff Utilities includes ore mining alerts that notify staff when valuable ores are mined, helping detect suspicious behavior such as X-ray usage. Additional administrative tools include chat muting and clearing, a player checking system with client brand detection, and a complete player reset command.

The plugin integrates natively with LuckPerms, offering a clean and flexible permission structure. It features a sleek dark blue themed message style and full customization through config.yml, allowing server owners to customize vanish and mod mode messages, toggle features such as the credits command, and tailor the plugin to their server’s needs.

Developed by Eryx, Warden Staff Utilities is optimized for modern Minecraft server environments and built specifically for Spigot/Paper 1.21+.
